course_name_original: Electrotecnia aplicada a la ingeniería mecánica (1791)

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and application of electrical installation design software

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 80% from the written exam and 20% from practical work. The written exam has two parts: Theory (30% weight in the exam) and Problems (70% weight in the exam). A minimum of 35% must be obtained in each part, and an overall exam score of 40% is required. If any minimum is not met, the exam grade will be failing. Practical work is assessed based on attendance, completion, and/or a final test. The continuous assessment grade is valid for the current and subsequent academic year. Students may opt out of continuous assessment, in which case the final grade is 90% from the theory and problems exam and 10% from the practical exam.
